ov: Large, semiaquatic boas of tropical South America. The green anaconda is the heaviest snake in the world and one of the longest, reaching over 6 m.

why.dg: Encounters with people can be dangerous, but anacondas don't regularly hunt humans.
why.ac: Mostly nocturnal and aquatic, lurking almost fully submerged.

df: Large prey such as capybaras, deer, caimans and even jaguars, though such big meals are rare.
fx: Its genus name, Eunectes, means “good swimmer”.
